scenes.text: Cleopatra lived closer to the *Moon landing* than to the *Great Pyramid.*
The Great Pyramid was built around *2560 BC.*
Cleopatra was born about *2,500 years later,* in 69 BC.
By her time, the pyramids were already *ancient ruins.*
Then came the *Moon landing* in 1969, about *2,000 years* after her.
History is *far stranger* than the order we picture it in.
Follow for more *lost secrets* of history.
